# shapes/shape_build_mirror.asm: Shape builder: mirrored copy of the 9 sprite parts for facing 1

Range `$33E7-$36A1`. Source: [shapes/shape_build_mirror.asm](../../../../src/shapes/shape_build_mirror.asm). Index: [the reference](../../index.md).

## Names

<a id="shape_build_mirrored"></a>
### [`shape_build_mirrored`](../../../../src/shapes/shape_build_mirror.asm#L6) `$33E7`

*label*

Mirrored copy for facing 1. Slot order: row 1 takes parts 2,1,0, row 2 parts 5,4,3, row 3 parts 8,7,6 (columns exchanged). Each part goes through shape_copy_mirrored_part with the store bases destination-2, destination and destination+2.

<a id="shape_copy_mirrored_part"></a>
### [`shape_copy_mirrored_part`](../../../../src/shapes/shape_build_mirror.asm#L297) `$365F`

*routine*

Copies part A mirrored: source $8000 + part*64 via $7f00 and shape_part_lo. For each of the 21 lines it exchanges bytes 0 and 2 and mirrors each byte with $7e00 (pixel pairs reversed). It copies 63 bytes. Called 9 times from shape_build_mirrored.

- **Called from:** [`$3437`](../../../../src/shapes/shape_build_mirror.asm#L52), [`$347B`](../../../../src/shapes/shape_build_mirror.asm#L82), [`$34BF`](../../../../src/shapes/shape_build_mirror.asm#L112), [`$3503`](../../../../src/shapes/shape_build_mirror.asm#L142), [`$3547`](../../../../src/shapes/shape_build_mirror.asm#L172), [`$358B`](../../../../src/shapes/shape_build_mirror.asm#L202), [`$35CF`](../../../../src/shapes/shape_build_mirror.asm#L232), [`$3613`](../../../../src/shapes/shape_build_mirror.asm#L262), [`$3657`](../../../../src/shapes/shape_build_mirror.asm#L292)
- **Reads:** [`shape_part_page_table`](shape_lookup_tables.md#shape_part_page_table), [`shape_page_offset`](../../memory-map.md#shape_page_offset), [`shape_part_lo`](shape_build.md#shape_part_lo), [`shape_parts`](../graphics/fighter_shapes_8000.md#shape_parts), [`shape_mirror_table`](shape_lookup_tables.md#shape_mirror_table)
